subject.title: fix(whatsapp): add listGroupsLive for real-time group directory

question: Should WhatsApp live group discovery become a supported directory capability using gateway socket reuse plus an exclusive standalone lookup when no process owns the account?
rationale: This resolves a user-facing limitation but introduces a new authenticated provider query and connection lifecycle, and the PR body explicitly preserves that boundary for maintainer approval.

options.title: Approve the maintained capability
options.body: Accept live discovery after exact-head linked-account proof confirms safe ownership, query, credential persistence, and teardown behavior.

options.title: Restrict discovery to the gateway
options.body: Permit live listing only through an active gateway-owned socket, avoiding temporary standalone sessions but reducing CLI availability.

options.title: Retain config-backed discovery
options.body: Decline authenticated live lookup and improve setup guidance or diagnostics for obtaining group JIDs.

recommendation.title: Approve the maintained capability
recommendation.body: Accept live discovery after exact-head linked-account proof confirms safe ownership, query, credential persistence, and teardown behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the current assignee and authored the maintained architecture at the reviewed head.
